route.click_path: Direct curl GET of ncmcla.com returned HTTP 202 SiteGround robot challenge (sgcaptcha). Playwright Chromium navigated to https://ncmcla.com/price-transparency, the challenge auto-passed after ~6s without form submission, page loaded (title 'Price Transparency | North Caddo Medical Center'). Page contains one link: 'Click here to access our consumer shopping tool or download a machine readable copy' -> https://hospitalpricedisclosure.com/Default.aspx?ci=BJjMDMD*__*bCMJX36XzypOfA*-*. Then navigated to https://ncmcla.com/cms-hpt.txt in the same session, which rendered plain-text pointer content; same-origin fetch returned the exact bytes.
